results.statement: When [tool.sc-lint].runner.python names a venv, a leading python in any lint or test step argv that does not run an sc_lint.* wheel helper must resolve to that venv's interpreter on every OS.
results.quote:
(1) a leading `"python"` in any lint **or test** step argv resolves to that venv's interpreter on every OS
plain `python` steps use `runner.python`; `sc_lint.*` wheel helpers always use the kit interpreter and `runner.python` must never apply to them.
results.context: Issue acceptance text: https://github.com/randlee/sc-lint/issues/198#issuecomment-6513016954 (a)(1),(3) and (b) (re-registered from GH-198.runner-argv.2, ID-only change)
results.deterministic_check: Injected-platform argv tests: bin/python on Unix, Scripts\python.exe on Windows, for a lint step and a test step; a python -m sc_lint.* step is not rewritten.
